notes: Source title shows Part [] without a part number; Appendix A row 3 leaves Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan) placeholders. No version/date printed in the source PDF; source manifest may supply publication context.

6.15 (pp.4–5) defines total contract value including Value Added Tax; Appendix B (p.12) labels total value exclusive of VAT. Both are preserved; auditor must resolve application before concluding non-compliance.
Appendix A leaves exactly £500,000 between row 2 (<£500,000) and row 3 (>£500,000). Row 4 band says £2.5million or more but cell says in excess of £2.5million.

Appendix B row A begins above £1,000; no mandatory process is stated at or below £1,000. Rows B2 and C omit exactly £500,000. Rows B1/C below Threshold and D above Threshold leave equality unspecified.
Appendix C row E specifies below and greater than Threshold, leaving equality unspecified.
6.11 retains other member states wording; do not silently reinterpret its legal context.
All statutory Threshold parameters remain null; printed £1,000 / £25,000 / £500,000 / £2.5million amounts are preserved with inclusivity flags.

Page numbers are one-based PDF pages; quotes use pypdf plain extraction and preserve source extraction artefacts. Human visual checks and Claude skill execution remain pending as documented separately.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Obtain interpretation of these Rules from the Monitoring Officer or nominated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or any officer nominated by the Monitoring Officer for the purpose)
rules.verbatim_quote: The Monitoring Officer (or any officer nominated by the Monitoring Officer for the purpose) shall be responsible for interpreting these Rules.

rules.condition: service contract exceeding the Goods & Services Threshold
rules.required_action: Document consideration of economic, social and environmental wellbeing when procuring the service.
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and e nvironmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Confirm an existing budgetary provision within the Council-approved Budget before entering the contract.
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in ac cordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award over £500,000
rules.required_action: Treat the contract award as a Key Decision.
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Obtain Appendix A approval before award where the Service Director lacks delegated authority.
rules.approver: roles specified in Appendix A
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: Publish expenditure exceeding £500, including supplier and contractor payments.
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: goods or services invitation to tender over £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every invitation to tender for goods or services exceeding £5,000.
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts in progress and awarded with value, duration and supplier.
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board monthly in the required format.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: above relevant Procurement Legislation threshold, except compliant framework further competition
rules.required_action: Advertise above-threshold opportunities on the CDP before other media, except further competitions under compliant frameworks.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising me dium (such as a trade journal etc) . However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.condition: contract of potential cross border interest
rules.required_action: Publicise contracts of potential cross-border interest so tenderers from other member states can participate.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is of potential cross border interest then it must be publicised to ensure that tenderers from other member states have an opportunity to participate and the process is conducted in a fair and transparent manner.

rules.condition: CDP notices
rules.required_action: Obtain approval and issuance of CDP notices by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Do not artificially split or disaggregate contracts to avoid the legislation or Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract estimated above the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders through the Council Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Specify tender format in the Portal and invitation and lock electronic tenders securely until opening date and time.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: late tender
rules.required_action: Reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer confirms exceptional circumstances and other tenders remain unopened.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Have a Procurement Officer open electronic tenders and retain the e-tendering audit record.
rules.approver: Procurement Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Evaluate all quotes and tenders using criteria notified in advance.
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: quote or tender award
rules.required_action: Award on most advantageous best value rather than price alone unless the Service Director approves an exception in advance.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: waiver for contracts of more than £24,999.99 under 7.2
rules.required_action: Record reasons in writing for the Executive Director or Chief Executive discretionary waiver.
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: waiver or exception request
rules.required_action: Seek waivers only in advance and exceptional circumstances from the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception v alues and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: contracts up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval of the exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: contracts above relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: Have the S.151 Officer consult the Monitoring Officer and Executive Director and secure a board-approved exception report, or report retrospectively for the stated urgency exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer; Monitoring Officer; appropriate Executive Director; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: contracts over £500,000
rules.required_action: Obtain an Executive recommendation by S.151 and Monitoring Officers supported by a report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer; Monitoring Officer; Executive; relevant board; Corporate Board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: all exceptions or waivers
rules.required_action: Fully document all exceptions or waivers.
rules.verbatim_quote: be fully documented;

rules.condition: competitive process not excluded by Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Submit a written exception report with reasons to the relevant board in advance through the named director.
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director ( which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: all exceptions or waivers
rules.required_action: Obtain recorded S.151 approval confirming the reasons are genuinely exceptional.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for wa ivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.condition: Purchasing Scheme used
rules.required_action: Seek advice confirming entitlement, coverage and compliance before using a Purchasing Scheme.
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: above-Threshold awarded contract subject to Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Have the relevant Service Director produce the written procurement report.
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the r elevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: report under 9.1
rules.required_action: Retain the procurement report for three years.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Retain procurement procedure documentation for three years from award.
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: contracts detailed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: Use written contracts in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: sealed contracts
rules.required_action: Have Legal Services retain all sealed contract documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Formally notify the procurement lead or nominated officer of every award for recording on the Council Contract Register.
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead f or Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: Standard Form of Agreement amended
rules.required_action: Have the Service Director prepare amendments to the Standard Form and obtain Monitoring Officer approval.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by th e relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include the works, supplies, goods, services and other deliverables.
rules.verbatim_quote: the works, supplies /goods, services, material, matters or things to be carried out or supplied;

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include the time for performance.
rules.verbatim_quote: the time within which the contract is to be performed;

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include quality requirements and standards.
rules.verbatim_quote: the quality requirements and/or standards that must be met;

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Require appropriate contractor insurance.
rules.verbatim_quote: requirements on the contractor to hold and maintain appropriate insurance;

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include consequences for non-compliance with obligations.
rules.verbatim_quote: the consequences of the contractor failing to comply with contractual obligations in whole or in part;

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Require contractor compliance with relevant legislation including equalities and health and safety.
rules.verbatim_quote: requirements on the contractor to comply with all relevant legislation, including (but not limited to) equalities and health and safety legislation;

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include personal-data clauses and complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment for all contracts.
rules.verbatim_quote: clauses regarding personal data and its use by the contractor and/or the Council respectively. Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include cancellation and recovery rights for improper conduct or a Bribery Act offence.
rules.verbatim_quote: the entitlement of the Council to cancel the contract and recover losses in the event that the contractor acted improperly (e .g. seeking to influence the Council to give the contractor any contract) or committed an offence under the Bribery Act 2010.

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include payment within 30 days from the invoice being valid and undisputed.
rules.verbatim_quote: any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed; and

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Flow the payment obligations down through subcontracts.
rules.verbatim_quote: any subcontract imposes the same obligations upon the subcontractor, and requires that the subcontractor imposes such obligations in any further subcontract.

rules.condition: all contracts, as a minimum where appropriate under 10.7
rules.required_action: Include specifications or briefs addressing delivery, quality, sustainability, efficiency and enforceability.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce th e delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: Obtain written authorisation before relaxing full indemnities.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writ ing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: performance bond required
rules.required_action: Include the performance bond in the Invitation to Tender in a Legal Services approved form.
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: performance bond not considered necessary under 11.4
rules.required_action: Prepare a written risk assessment.
rules.verbatim_quote: undertake a risk assessment in writing; and

rules.condition: performance bond not considered necessary under 11.4
rules.required_action: Seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and

rules.condition: performance bond not considered necessary under 11.4
rules.required_action: Keep the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.
rules.verbatim_quote: keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance; construction/professional services conditions apply to respective subclauses
rules.required_action: Set adequate insurance levels in consultation with the finance/property director or nominated officer.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer set adequate levels of insurance cover (including employer’s liability, public liability and any other as determined by the needs of the particular contract);

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance; construction/professional services conditions apply to respective subclauses
rules.required_action: Ensure the contractor holds insurance and maintains current or renewed policies in consultation with the finance/property director.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer ensure that such insurances are held by the contractor and that the policies concerned are up to date (and/or renewed, as necessary, during the relevant period);

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance; construction/professional services conditions apply to respective subclauses
rules.required_action: Confirm contractor status under the Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme in consultation with the finance/property director.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer who must ensure the contractor’s status under the Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme (for construction contracts);

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance; construction/professional services conditions apply to respective subclauses
rules.required_action: Set professional indemnity cover case by case in consultation with the finance/property director.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property set an appropriate level of professional indemnity insurance for each specific contract that require professional and/or design services (this should not be a standard level but be assessed on a case by case basis).

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Keep the Common Seal safely in the Monitoring Officer’s custody.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Common Seal of the Council (the “ Seal”) shall be in the Custody of the Monitoring Officer and kept in a safe place at their discretion.

rules.condition: use of the Seal
rules.required_action: Affix the Seal only to an approved document or proposal.
rules.approver: Council or Executive; appropriate Committee; officer with delegated powers
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal may be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document or proposa l that has been approved by a resolution of the Council or Executive, or of an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.

rules.condition: affixing the Seal
rules.required_action: Have the Monitoring Officer or designated officer attest and witness sealing in writing.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or duly designated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Keep a consecutively numbered sealing record signed by the person attesting.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: documents required to be sealed
rules.required_action: Affix the Seal to every document requiring sealing, including the specified petitions, mortgages and transfers.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal shall be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document required to be sealed, including but not limited to:

rules.condition: contract value above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Seal all above-Threshold goods, services, works and concession contracts.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: document necessary for legal proceedings
rules.required_action: Have the Monitoring Officer or authorised officer sign documents necessary for legal proceedings unless a stated exception applies.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where any document will be a necessary step in legal proceedings on behalf of the Council it shall, unless any enactment otherwise requires or authorises or the Council shall have given the necessary authority to some other person for the purpose of such proceedings, be signed by the Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer.

rules.condition: execution of document not required by law to be sealed
rules.required_action: Keep a register of documents executed without a required seal and use the Monitoring Officer or designated signatory.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or designated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: Use only the Monitoring Officer or nominated officer to select and instruct Counsel.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: up to relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain award by the Service Director or officer nominated in writing.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director or officers nominated in writing
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: above relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Obtain director award following S151 and Monitoring Officer recommendation and a board-approved written report.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director; S151 officer; Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Follow Key Decision delegation, consultations, recommendations, board report and Call-In/Forward Plan requirements.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director; Portfolio Holder; Executive Director; S151 officer; Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (Call- In) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: table band £2.5million or more; cell says in excess of £2.5million (discrepancy)
rules.required_action: Obtain Executive approval and quarterly procurement reports with the stated delegated award consultations.
rules.approver: Executive; Service Director; Portfolio Holder; S.151 Officer; Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: above £1,000 and less than £25,000 (exclusive of VAT)
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source.
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods/services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold (exclusive of VAT)
rules.required_action: Invite at least three quotes via the Portal, including SME/VCSE and local suppliers where appropriate and possible, and publish a CDP contract notice.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works/concession/light touch: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 (exclusive of VAT)
rules.required_action: Invite at least three quotes via the Portal, including SME/VCSE and local suppliers where appropriate and possible, and publish a CDP contract notice.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works/concession/light touch: above £500,000 and less than relevant Threshold (exclusive of VAT)
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive process and seek at least five written tenders via the Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal. An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: all listed categories above relevant Threshold (exclusive of VAT)
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive tender under the legislation with at least five written tenders where appropriate via the Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal. An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: contract excluded under Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer approval and applicable board approval.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by Provider Selection Regime
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process.
rules.verbatim_quote: Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: Purchasing Scheme without further competition because competition undertaken for Council or public sector body
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer approval and applicable board approval.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: existing contract provides for the extension
rules.required_action: Obtain S151 Officer approval of the permitted extension.
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation provided for by existing contract or modification permitted by legislation; below/greater than Threshold approval differs
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written Monitoring Officer and S151 approval below Threshold, or relevant-board approval on a recommended report above Threshold.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; S151 Officer; relevant board above Threshold
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required. For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: social care services under Appendix C row F(a)-(f)
rules.required_action: Maintain reasons for provider choice on the individual case notes.
rules.approver: Service Directors
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: exemption applied and annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain relevant-board approval for exempt contracts above the Threshold.
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.
